== Summary ==
Original Japanese foil face of [[Death Star (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Death Star]] from [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]]. Shop photograph of this Japanese Reflections II foil printing. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 2001.
